question:
Complete the given sentence with an appropriate homophone from the given options.

It is better to focus on your _______ than to wander aimlessly.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"career"** refers to an occupation or profession, especially one requiring special training, followed as one's lifework. (व्यवसाय)

 
 
• **Example: **She has a successful** career **in medicine.
 
 
 
• **"Carrier" **refers to a person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something. (वाहक)
 
 
• **Example: **The water **carrier** brought fresh water to the village every day.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **career**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Carrier** (वाहक): A person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something.

 
 
• **Example:** The aircraft **carrier** is a vital part of the naval fleet.
 
 
 
• **Courier** (संदेशवाहक): A person or company that delivers messages, packages, and mail.
 
 
• **Example:** The** courier** delivered the package within two days.
 
 
 
• **Carreer** (Incorrect spelling of 'career'): This is an incorrect spelling of the word **'career'**.
 
 
• **Example:** This is not a valid word and does not have a definition.
